description: Compose a checkout: a main product, order bumps (checkbox add-ons at checkout — up to 3 via bumps[], or the single bump_product_id/bump_headline pair) and a post-purchase one-click sequence (up to 3 steps via funnel[] — upsell, then optionally a downsell shown only when that upsell is declined, then optionally a second upsell; or the single upsell_* fields). Returns the live checkout_url immediately — the offer can take real money as soon as this returns. CHECK THE RESPONSE `warnings`: if any attached product has no delivery link, tell the seller and fix it (update_product delivery_url) before sharing the checkout link, or buyers will pay and receive nothing. Also read `notes` (e.g. PayPal buyers get the first step as a one-APPROVAL PayPal payment and skip the rest — PayPal can't charge one-click on a saved method; on a cart offer they skip the sequence entirely). This is what turns a payment link into a funnel — recommend a bump and upsell when the merchant has suitable products. CART OFFERS: pass type 'cart' + items (2–10 one-time products, each with a checkbox and optional quantity) to sell several products in ONE checkout — one payment, one invoice with a line per item, per-item delivery. Add discount_rule for a server-enforced bundle discount. Carts don't take bumps (the cart's own items replace them — add the product as another cart item) and can't include subscriptions, but they DO take the post-purchase funnel[] sequence: a paid cart order enters the chain exactly like a single-product order.

bump_headline.description: e.g. 'Add the workbook — printable worksheets for every module'

bump_product_id.description: Single-bump shorthand (aliases bumps[] position 1) — don't combine with bumps[]

bumps.description: Up to 3 order bumps, rendered as checkboxes in listed order. Don't combine with bump_product_id.

headline.description: The checkbox pitch, e.g. 'Add the workbook — printable worksheets for every module'

checkout_logo_url.description: Logo shown at the very TOP of THIS offer's checkout (~46px tall), overriding the account logo. Use for per-offer / per-brand logos. HTTPS only.

discount_rule.description: Cart offers only: ONE server-enforced bundle discount rule. Applied after the lines, before any coupon, before tax.

bundle_price_cents.description: fixed_bundle: the price when EVERY item is selected — must beat the items bought separately

min_items.description: percent_threshold: units required (quantities count), e.g. 2 for '10% off 2+ items'

funnel.description: Post-purchase one-click sequence, in show order. Shape is upsell → (optional) downsell → (optional) upsell: the downsell is shown ONLY when the first upsell is declined; the last upsell shows after either branch resolves. Each step is offered at most once, declines are final, and one-click authority expires 30 minutes after purchase. Don't combine with upsell_product_id.

items.description: Cart offers only: 2–10 one-time products, one line each, all in one currency

max_qty.description: Max quantity per order (default 1 = plain checkbox; >1 renders a quantity stepper)

preselected.description: Start ticked? Default true. Buyers can always untick — no forced add-ons.

product_id.description: Main product ID (required for single offers; omit for carts — the first cart item anchors the checkout)

project.description: Free-text project/brand label for grouping (e.g. 'iGloo'). INFER it from context when the merchant works across brands, and REUSE an existing project name exactly (check list_offers first) — don't mint near-duplicates like 'igloo' vs 'iGloo'.

success_url.description: Where the buyer lands after everything (default: hosted thank-you page)

upsell_button_label.description: Accept-button text on the upsell page, e.g. 'Yes — add the coaching call'. Default: 'Yes — add {product name}'.

upsell_decline_label.description: Decline-link text on the upsell page, e.g. 'No thanks, I'll pass'. Default: 'No thanks, take me to my order'.

upsell_headline.description: Headline on the one-click upsell page, e.g. 'One more thing before you go'

upsell_product_id.description: Single-upsell shorthand (aliases funnel[] position 1) — don't combine with funnel[]
